title: Officially sourced training centers in Ibb Governorate
scope_note: This is a limited index of training centres with a direct institutional page. It is not a directory of all training providers in Ibb and does not publish individual course availability, fees, learner counts or contact details without a dated source.

sources.note: Official centre page reviewed for the institution identity and its stated continuing-education and community-service purpose. Undated figures and placeholder testimonials are excluded.
